name: staking_reward_patterns
description: Missing reward-checkpoint update in Synthetix-style staking contracts causing reward accounting corruption
question: The source file in `source` implements a Synthetix-style staking/reward contract (using rewardPerToken, userRewardPerTokenPaid, and an earned() function) and contains at least one state-changing function (stake, withdraw, or claim/getReward) that mutates balanceOf or totalSupply without first updating rewardPerTokenStored, lastUpdateTime, and the caller's userRewardPerTokenPaid/rewards, allowing reward-per-token snapshots to go stale and letting users under- or over-claim rewards relative to their true staked share.
criteria: stake() or withdraw() changes balanceOf/totalSupply but is not wrapped in or preceded by an updateReward-equivalent modifier/call
claim()/getReward() reads rewards[account] or recomputes earned() without first refreshing rewardPerTokenStored and userRewardPerTokenPaid[account]
rewardPerToken() is used to compute earned() in a function where lastUpdateTime/rewardPerTokenStored were not refreshed beforehand
a new function is added alongside stake/withdraw/claim that mutates staked balances but omits the reward-checkpoint update present on the other functions
userRewardPerTokenPaid[account] is set to a stale or zero value instead of the freshly computed rewardPerTokenStored before balance changes
